greeting-scenario-and-review.label: Greeting Scenario and Review
greeting-scenario-and-review.summary: Combine greetings, a simple check-in, thanks, and a closing into a short beginner Kreyòl exchange.

greeting-scenario-and-review-choice.title: Open the conversation
greeting-scenario-and-review-choice.prompt: Which phrase is the best opening for this short exchange?

help.concept: A simple conversation usually begins with a greeting before the check-in question.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

greeting-scenario-and-review-fill.title: Complete the response
greeting-scenario-and-review-fill.prompt: Choose the word that completes the polite answer.
greeting-scenario-and-review-fill.hint: Use the complete response pattern practiced in the lesson.

help.concept: A polite check-in response combines a status phrase with a thank-you expression.
help.hint_1: Look at the full response pattern from the lesson.
help.hint_2: Choose the option that completes the response naturally.

greeting-scenario-and-review-listen.title: Hear the check-in
greeting-scenario-and-review-listen.prompt: Listen, then build the Kreyòl question you hear.
greeting-scenario-and-review-listen.hint: Build the familiar question from this module.

help.concept: Recognizing Kijan ou ye? by ear helps the learner follow a real greeting exchange.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

greeting-scenario-and-review-voice.title: Give the full response
greeting-scenario-and-review-voice.prompt: Say: Mwen byen, mèsi. E ou menm?
greeting-scenario-and-review-voice.hint: Say the response and return question together.

help.concept: Speaking practice compares the recognized transcript with the authored Kreyòl exchange.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

greeting-scenario-and-review-voice.targetText: Mwen byen, mèsi. E ou menm?

greeting-scenario-and-review-build.title: Build the mini exchange
greeting-scenario-and-review-build.prompt: Arrange the chunks into a natural greeting and check-in.
greeting-scenario-and-review-build.hint: Greeting first, then the check-in question.

help.concept: Short conversational chunks become useful when they are placed in a natural sequence.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

greeting-scenario-and-review-write.title: Write the goodbye
greeting-scenario-and-review-write.prompt: Type the Kreyòl goodbye practiced in this lesson.

help.concept: A closing expression completes a short beginner conversation.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

mini-dialogue.title: A short greeting exchange
mini-dialogue.bodyMarkdown:
Here is a complete beginner exchange:

**A:** Bonjou!

**B:** Bonjou!

**A:** Kijan ou ye?

**B:** Mwen byen, mèsi. E ou menm?

**A:** Mwen byen tou.

Every line uses language from this module.

close-conversation.title: Orevwa
close-conversation.bodyMarkdown:
**Orevwa** is a useful way to say goodbye.

A complete beginner interaction can be very short: greet, ask how the person is, answer, and close politely.

conversation-flow.title: Think in small reusable chunks
conversation-flow.bodyMarkdown:
You now have several reusable chunks:

- **Bonjou!**
- **Kijan ou ye?**
- **Mwen byen, mèsi.**
- **E ou menm?**
- **Orevwa.**

Practice the chunks in order until the exchange feels familiar.
